rawFindings.title: Multiple app.VERB calls for same path may rerun route logic, increasing overhead
rawFindings.explanation: The refactor replaced caching _baseRoutes with directly calling this._router.route(path) in app.VERB and app.all methods. This removes the previous caching for base routes, potentially causing repeated route creation overhead for identical paths in multiple calls.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore caching of base routes to avoid repeated route creation for identical paths in multiple app.VERB calls by reintegrating _baseRoutes cache or equivalent mechanism.

rawFindings.explanation: The original method to get or create a route in app.VERB methods uses a custom _baseRoute method that caches routes by path with ignoring case and path type considerations. The change replaced that with direct calls to this._router.route(path) which may create new route instances for the same path on each call, leading to multiple handlers being registered separately for the same path and method, causing potentially conflicting route handling. rawFindings.suggestion: Restore use of the _baseRoute method for route retrieval in app.VERB and app.all methods to maintain consistent route instances and route caching for the same path, preventing multiple route instances for the same path.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect route retrieval causing multiple handlers for the same path
rawFindings.explanation: The method overrides for HTTP verbs now use this._router.route(path) instead of a cached base route (_baseRoute). This causes a new Route instance to be created each time for the same path, leading to multiple handlers being registered separately rather than shared, breaking route handler overriding behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the usage of the _baseRoute method to ensure a single Route instance per path is reused, preventing duplicate route handlers.

rawFindings.title: Removed _baseRoute cache causing potential performance degradation and behavioral change
rawFindings.explanation: The _baseRoute method and associated _baseRoutes cache were removed. This disables caching and reuse of Route instances by path, which previously helped efficient and consistent route handler management.
rawFindings.suggestion: Reinstate the _baseRoute method and caching mechanism to preserve route reuse and avoid unintended side effects.
